boundaryGate.question: Does the real BiliDili moduleMining flow prove the P11 binding-rich selector behavior change end to end, especially Entry B planned per-module dimensions instead of scope-only/all-dimension behavior?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace/data-root using the current Alembic source with commit 25a86eed857294d63ee671203d3634859a6709fa loaded. Cover both in-process moduleMining entries: Entry A daemon ModuleMiningWorkflow and Entry B KnowledgeRescanWorkflow Step 7 moduleMining/per-module route. Do not test Plugin host-agent moduleMining as P11 source scope.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller reviewed Alembic commit 25a86eed857294d63ee671203d3634859a6709fa, the shared selector source, Entry B wiring, and AlembicAgent compatibility source.
Controller reran Alembic focused tests, Alembic build:check, Alembic boundary checks, AlembicAgent moduleMining test, and AlembicAgent core-import boundary check.
Controller accepted the Alembic source task only; no AlembicAgent source follow-up is currently authorized.
realScenarioConditions: Run directly against the real BiliDili workspace/data root authorized by the state root; no sandbox copy.
Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Ollama for embeddings.
Use rebuild/reset between major runs when needed through the authorized BiliDili flow, and do not manually edit SQLite/source/provider state to create a pass.
Record loaded repo pins for Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicAgent, AlembicPlugin, BiliDili, and Test.
successMeans: Entry A and Entry B both run through real moduleMining against BiliDili and expose selected module payloads containing planned per-module dimensions.
Entry B proves the behavior change: selected modules only mine their planned dimensions, not every execution dimension.
For each selected module, recipe_source_refs shows at least one source_path-backed recipe or an equivalent persisted source-ref-backed recipe evidence record.
coverage_ledger advances for module x dimension cells targeted by the run.
deep_mining_rounds does not advance for moduleMining because the stage guard excludes moduleMining from deepMining round accounting.
Agent fan-out child count equals selectedModules capped by the configured concurrency/scale cap, with the default concurrency behavior accounted for.
SQLite integrity remains ok, no stale active ProjectContext session/open round remains, and provider route remains DeepSeek plus local Qwen/Ollama.
failureMeans: Entry B has no plannedDimensions evidence, still mines all execution dimensions for a scoped module, or cannot be triggered through a real route.
Recipe/source-ref persistence does not materialize for selected modules.
coverage_ledger does not move for targeted module x dimension cells.
deep_mining_rounds advances for moduleMining, implying the stage guard regressed.
Agent fan-out does not respect selected module count/cap or fails to consume dimensions/dimensionIds.
SQLite corruption, stale session/open round, wrong provider route, or wrong root.
cannotConclude: Do not conclude P11 is accepted, G4/G6 passed, P12 ready, or the whole demand is complete solely from this Test card.
Do not use a successful Entry A alone to prove Entry B behavior change.
Do not treat empty source refs, 0-vs-0 coverage, or aggregate/root-only rows as success.
Do not diagnose or modify Alembic/AlembicAgent source from the Test window; block with evidence if a product defect is found.
stopConditions: Missing loaded Alembic commit 25a86ee or equivalent source proof.
Entry B cannot be triggered or lacks plannedDimensions evidence.
Any operation would require manual data mutation or product source edits from Test.

evidenceRequired: A Test report and summary JSON under the state root.

Raw tmp JSON/log artifacts for Entry A and Entry B showing request, selected modules, dimensions/plannedDimensions, fan-out, job/result status, source refs, coverage ledger, rounds, sessions, provider config, and SQLite integrity.
Exact repo pins and command outputs.
Explicit PASS/BLOCKED verdict with residual risks and next recommendation.
allowedOperations: Restart/rebuild the BiliDili Alembic test environment as needed through existing Test harnesses.
Run public/daemon or in-process moduleMining routes needed to exercise Entry A and Entry B.
Capture logs, job results, developer events, SQLite snapshots, provider config, session/round snapshots, and source-ref/coverage evidence.
Use read-only source inspection to verify loaded commit and route shape.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit product source in Test.
Do not manually edit SQLite, sessions, coverage rows, source refs, provider config, or BiliDili source to manufacture a pass.
Do not run destructive preclean outside the authorized BiliDili data-root flow.
Do not write thread ids to tracked docs or backfill.
